antifurto.biometricPrompt: Authenticate to turn off the alarm
antifurto.needsDeviceAuthBody: Guard Mode can only be turned off with your fingerprint or the device lock. Set up a screen lock in Android settings before enabling it.

websites.subtitle: Sites blocked in the browser
websites.coverageBody: We read the address typed into the browser (Chrome and other popular ones) to block the site. It doesn't cover private/incognito tabs or sites opened inside other apps (like Instagram's built-in browser).

addChild.title: How to add a child
addChild.body:
1) Install WardYou on the child's phone.
2) They create an account and join your family with the invite code.
3) You approve the request choosing the "Child" role.

Done: protected mode turns on for their device and you manage everything here.

shieldSetup.title: Harden the protection
shieldSetup.subtitle: Some phones kill background apps to save battery. Do these steps once so the protection never stops.
shieldSetup.adminBody: Turn on so WardYou can't be uninstalled from this device.
shieldSetup.batteryBody: Allow WardYou to ignore battery optimization.
shieldSetup.overlayBody: Allow the overlay so the blocked screen appears instantly.
shieldSetup.autostartBody: Enable WardYou's autostart on the screen that opens.
shieldSetup.recentsLockBody: Open recent apps, drag the WardYou card down and tap the padlock. That way "clear all" won't turn the protection off.
shieldSetup.popupBody: Under "Other permissions", allow "Display pop-up windows while running in the background".
shieldSetup.diagOk: Blocked screen tested and working on this device. ✓
shieldSetup.diagFail: The blocked screen couldn't appear ({{detail}}). Grant the overlay permission above.

accessibility.title: Accessibility is off
accessibility.body: Without it, app limits and blocks aren't enforced — they only show on screen.
accessibility.oemHint: Tap, then go to: Downloaded apps → WardYou Protection

accessibilityDead.body: Accessibility is on in Settings, but the service isn't running — nothing is being blocked. Turn it off and on again to restart it.
accessibilityDead.oemHint: Tap, then go to: Downloaded apps → WardYou Protection

accessibilityUnknown.body: This doesn't mean it's down — only that the app couldn't check right now. It will try again on its own.

usageAccess.title: Usage access is off
usageAccess.body: Without it, screen time isn't counted and the daily limit is never reached.

locationPermission.body: Your family can't see where you are, and SOS goes out without a location.

locationServices.body: GPS is turned off system-wide. Even with permission granted, nothing location-related works.
